title: Old ifm-deploy.vercel.app address: complete scan (27 Oct)
verdict: Full read-only scan after the old address showed on the projector in Stock Rush PRO on 27 Oct. 3 places print it in the code, and 10 classroom games build their QR from whatever address the host opened, so old bookmarks put it on every projector. The complete fix: change the 3 written-in addresses, add one redirect from the old address to games.investingformummies.com, and update Hiral's bookmarks.

items.text: Stock Rush PRO: the projector's 'Join on your phone' box prints ifm-deploy.vercel.app/stock-rush-pro, written into the code (stock-rush-pro/host-view.jsx). Show games.investingformummies.com/stock-rush-pro.
Teen Stock Rush: the same box prints ifm-deploy.vercel.app/stock-rush (stock-rush/host-view.jsx). Change it to the games address (teen version: owner rule says don't edit, so decide first).
Swayamvar: the join QR is built from ifm-deploy.vercel.app/swayamvar (swayamvar/ui-common.js and .jsx). Build it from the games address.

Add one redirect rule: anyone opening ifm-deploy.vercel.app goes to games.investingformummies.com, same page. 10 classroom games (Quiz, Wealth Hack, MF Manager, Sapno Ka Ghar, Broke by Friday, Swipe Right LIVE, Lifestyle Time Machine LIVE, both Stock Rushes) build their QR from the address the host opened, so this one rule fixes every QR and every old bookmark at once.
Update Hiral's browser bookmarks and class slides to games.investingformummies.com links (and the host links once rooms are per-session).
Share messages and printed PDF footers in Fund YOUR Goal, Goal Tracker and the classic hub say 'ifm-deploy.vercel.app' (5 places). Change them to the right address (www/tools once the tools move).
The classic hub loads 9 embedded games from ifm-deploy.vercel.app. Switch to same-site links (moot once the classic hub is retired).

18 logo and image references load from ifm-deploy.vercel.app (Crorepati Lane, MF Manager art, Fund YOUR Goal, Goal Tracker, Quiz, Sapno Ka Ghar, Slash the Scam, Money Map, Snakes & Ladders, classic hub). Switch to relative paths, and shrink the 1 MB round logo while at it.
Stock Rush PRO activity feed shows a broken question-mark-in-a-diamond symbol before 'Suraj locked in' on the projector (seen in class 27 Oct). Fix the lock line's emoji.
Tidy-ups: Snakes & Ladders page meta points at the old address; the unused WordPress publish scripts (bbflive/g8/swayamvar _wp_ commands) and game-reels content links still mention it.
